pricing.title: Start free. Stay as long as you like.
pricing.body: The free plan covers most people. A bigger plan is on its way.

pro.name: Pro
pro.note: For heavy spenders and small businesses.
pro.waitNote: Not available yet. The free plan has everything in the meantime.

free.a: Yes. The free plan includes up to 30 receipts and 50 questions to Wara’a every month, with every feature. A Pro plan with higher limits is coming.

formats.a: Photos and images (JPEG, PNG, WebP) or PDF receipts. You can upload several at once from your phone’s camera or gallery.

accuracy.a: No, and we don’t pretend it is. That’s why every receipt sits next to its original, unclear ones get flagged with a reason, and you can edit anything.

privacy.a: Only you. Every request is tied to your account. You can export all of your data or delete your account and everything in it at any time.

currencies.q: I pay in more than one currency
currencies.a: No problem. Totals are always kept per currency and never mixed. You can switch currencies on the dashboard, or ask Wara’a to convert.

language.a: Yes. The app is in Arabic and English, and you can ask Wara’a questions in either language.
